notes: Extracted directly from the supplied ROM binary.
Stats are base stats, not calculated in-battle stats.
Emerald EX 1.0.4 uses the classic Gen 3 type ID ordering with Fairy appended as ID 18.
Mono-type Pokémon store the same type in both type slots; types collapses those to one readable value.
baseStatTotal is the sum of HP, Attack, Defense, Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, and Speed.
